description_en: Unbinds tags from data migration, synchronization, and change tracking instances
description_zh: 为迁移、同步和订阅实例解绑标签
kebab_example: aliyun dts untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id dtsntk10k6r12v0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定实例所在地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. The only valid value is ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型定义。唯一取值：ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to unbind instance tags from the instance. Valid values:

true: Unbinds instance tags from the instance.
false: Does not unbind instance tags. You must specify the tags to unbind in the TagKey.N parameter.

You must specify at least one of TagKey.N and this parameter.
If you specify both TagKey.N and this parameter, this parameter does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
是否解绑实例的全部标签，取值：

true：是。解绑实例的全部标签。
false：否。需在TagKey.N参数传入需解绑的实例标签。

TagKey.N和本参数至少传入一个。
如果同时传入了TagKey.N和本参数，则本参数不生效
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the data migration, synchronization, or change tracking instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html operation to query instance IDs.
N specifies the sequence number of the instance ID. For example, ResourceId.0 specifies the first instance ID, and ResourceId.1 specifies the second instance ID. You can unbind tags from 1 to 50 instances at a time
parameters.help_zh:
数据迁移、同步和订阅实例的ID，可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html接口查询。
N表示传入第几个实例ID。例如ResourceId.0表示传入第一个实例ID；ResourceId.1表示传入第二个实例ID。可以同时对1~50个实例解绑标签
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The tag key.
N specifies the sequence number of the tag key. For example, TagKey.0 specifies the first tag key, and TagKey.1 specifies the second tag key. You can unbind 1 to 20 tag keys at a time.
Empty strings are not allowed.
You must specify at least one of All and this parameter.
If you specify both All and this parameter, only this parameter takes effect
parameters.help_zh:
标签键。
N表示传入第几个标签的键。例如TagKey.0表示传入第一个标签的键；TagKey.1表示传入第二个标签的键。可以同时解绑1~20个标签键。
不允许传入空字符串。
All和本参数至少传入一个。
如果同时传入了All和本参数，则只有本参数生效
parameters.name: tag_key

ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回对应的错误信息
